subject: Penetration testing report: methodology acceptance, report age & remediation evidence
body:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@atlaspay.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions about pen test report age and scope acceptance

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this. We ran a full external penetration test in Sept 2024 (Redpoint Security) with a follow-up remediation verification in Jan 2025. I attached a redacted copy of the report and the remediation summary. Two quick questions for your security/compliance review:

- Is a Sept 2024 test still acceptable for SOC 2 evidence, or do you require a more recent test?
- Do you have minimum methodology/firm credentials we need to confirm (e.g., CVE/OWASP coverage, tester accreditation)?

If the report age is a concern, we can schedule a targeted retest. Let me know the acceptance window and any artifacts you need (logs, Jira IDs, PoC screenshots).

Regards,
Sam Taylor
Head of Compliance, Atlas Payments
sam.taylor@atlaspay.com
Attachments: AtlasPay_PenTest_20240915_redacted.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB), AtlasPay_Remediation_Summary_20250110.zip (ZIP, 800KB)

-----
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@atlaspay.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions about pen test report age and scope acceptance

Hi Sam — thanks for sending these over and for the clear attachments. Short answer up front: we typically accept external pen test reports as SOC 2 evidence if the test and a remediation verification are within a 12‑month window of our review date, but there are nuance rules depending on findings severity and whether the firm meets our baseline criteria.

What we look for (please share these explicitly if you can):
- Executive summary + scope (IP ranges, services, and exclusions).
- Test date and detailed methodology (OWASP Top 10 / API testing / authenticated vs unauthenticated).
- Vulnerability classification and CVSS scores where applicable.
- Proof of remediation/retest for critical/high items (retest report or screenshots + issue tracker IDs).
- Firm credentials: company background, one-page profile, and at least two sample engagement references.

Additional notes:
- If the report is older than 12 months but remediation verification is recent (within 12 months), we may accept it but reserve the right to request a targeted retest for any open critical/high findings.
- We require an independent third‑party tester (internal pen tests are not sufficient for SOC 2 evidence).
- Redacted reports are fine, but redactions cannot remove key evidence (e.g., vulnerability descriptions, PoCs).

Next steps: our security team will perform a quick triage of the materials you attached. If we need a retest, we'll propose a narrow scope (public-facing API endpoints + auth flows) to cut cost and time. Can you also share the Redpoint Security firm profile and the specific Jira IDs for the remedied items?

I'll loop in Dev (Dev Patel) from Ops so we can align on retest logistics if needed.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

-----
From: Redpoint Security <reports@redpointsec.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@atlaspay.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions about pen test report age and scope acceptance

Hi Rishi / Redwood team,

Attaching the Redpoint engagement summary and firm one‑pager as requested. Key facts:
- Engagement: External network + web application (authenticated)
- Test window: 2024-09-10 to 2024-09-16
- Remediation verification: 2025-01-10 (retest of critical findings + validation screenshots)
- Methodology: PTES + OWASP API guidelines; CVSS mapping included.

Attachments included: Redpoint_Engagement_Summary_202409.pdf, Redpoint_Firm_Profile_2024.pdf.

If you prefer, we can run a targeted retest focused on the two highest‑risk endpoints next week; cost would be significantly lower than a full test.

- Redpoint Security (reports@redpointsec.com)

-----
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@atlaspay.com>, Redpoint Security <reports@redpointsec.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions about pen test report age and scope acceptance

Thanks — that's helpful. Preliminary guidance from our compliance playbook:
- With a documented remediation verification dated 2025-01-10, this package should be acceptable as evidence for the SOC 2 cycle that starts in Q1 2026, assuming the retest covered the identified critical/high items.
- However, if any critical findings were deferred or mitigations were incomplete, we will require a targeted retest prior to sign‑off.

Dev — can you confirm whether the remediation artifacts included in the ZIP and the screenshots are sufficient for our auditor review, or do you want the vendor to provide live Jira links and retest tickets?

Sam — assuming Dev confirms, we expect to complete our internal review by 2026-02-05 and provide a formal acceptance note. If we need a retest, we'll scope and schedule with Redpoint.

Thanks,
Rishi

-----
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@atlaspay.com>, Redpoint Security <reports@redpointsec.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions about pen test report age and scope acceptance

Quick update from triage: the remediation ZIP looks good but is missing two retest ticket IDs we need for the auditor (JIRA‑1247, JIRA‑1253). Sam / Redpoint — can you drop those Jira links or export of the verification tickets? Once we have those, I can mark the package as "compliance-ready" and Rishi can sign the acceptance memo.

If the tickets cannot be shared, a signed attestation from your CTO listing the remediated CVEs + retest dates will also work, but printed Jira evidence is preferred.

Thanks — Dev
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

[Attachment stubs referenced earlier: AtlasPay_PenTest_20240915_redacted.pdf, AtlasPay_Remediation_Summary_20250110.zip]
